question: Question
defaultDirections: Select the answer you feel answers the question. When you are done, press {checkAnswer}. You will get feedback indicating correctness of your answer and how to proceed.
relatedContentDescription: This creates a collapsed area for content related to this question and is always shown
hintDescription: This is presented if the user gets the answer wrong
evidenceDescription: This is presented if the user gets the answer correct
markTheWordsDirections: {selectAll} the words that apply. Then press {checkAnswer} to test your answers. You will get feedback indicating correctness of your answer.
numCorrectOutOfGuessed: You have {correct} out of {total} correct ({guessed} guessed)
fillInTheBlanksDirections: Read the sentance and type or select the answer at each input. Once you set all your answers you can press {checkAnswer} to test your answers. You will get feedback indicating correctness of your answer.
